name: chic
description: Redesign a photo of your room and shop the result. Attach a room photo, say what to change, and Chic renders it into your photo with real products you can buy.

capabilities: Render paint, furniture, decor and style changes into a photo of your own room
Show a before/after comparison of the room
Show real products with prices for the furniture in the redesigned room
Keep editing the same room across several requests
Give a link to open the room on usechic.com
defaultPrompt: Redesign this room in a warm Japandi style
Paint these walls sage green and show me what to buy
Swap this sofa for a cognac leather one
